title: Song of ice and flame
flavor: Icarus, the Primordial Flame of Creation, reborn through a supernova, burning and rising in an eternal cycle. Kaldr, the Frost Wraith of Terminus, forged from the void’s silence, wielding the power of annihilation. Flame or ice, genesis or terminus, they counter each other, yet stand as the twin poles that hold the cosmos in balance. Upon the battlefield, fire erupts and frost descends.These most ancient Elemental Twins write the ultimate tale of opposition and coexistence between life and extinction across all heaven and earth.

entries.name: Ancient Apparition($1/Element/Mage), ability - Chilling touch
entries.detail: New chess piece. <Passive Ability> Grant Ancient Apparition attack speed bonus and trap its target in chilling frost with attack speed decreased and health recharge prevented. The ancient apparition’s eternal knowledge brings a frigid enchantment to his attacks.

entries.name: Phoenix($4/Element/Mage), ability - Sun Ray
entries.detail: New chess piece. <Active Ability: Activate Instant> Phoenix expels a beam of light at the cost of its own health. The beam damages enemies and heals allies for a base amount plus a percentage of their health. The percentage increases as the beam continues to fire. The vent through which such stellar energy flows is mere atoms wide.
